description: This file defines the interface for a radix tree data structure used in the lighttpd project. It includes function declarations for creating, freeing, inserting, removing, and looking up nodes within the radix tree, as well as iterating over its elements.

methods.name: li_radixtree_new
methods.description: Creates a new, empty radix tree.

methods.name: li_radixtree_free
methods.description: Frees the radix tree and its elements, using provided functions for deallocating data.

methods.name: li_radixtree_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the radix tree with the specified key and bits; returns previous data if key exists.

methods.name: li_radixtree_remove
methods.description: Removes the element with the specified key from the radix tree; returns the data of the removed node.

methods.name: li_radixtree_lookup
methods.description: Performs a longest prefix match lookup for the given key and bits.

methods.name: li_radixtree_lookup_exact
methods.description: Performs an exact match lookup for the given key and bits.

methods.name: li_radixtree_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all elements in the radix tree, applying the specified callback function.
